rationale: Wind damage to the policyholder's own roof structure (shingles on porch overhang) is straightforward property damage to real property.
claim_summary: Windstorm damage to back porch roof overhang with approximately four shingles blown off; estimated repair cost $400. No water intrusion or secondary damage reported. Claim is below the $2,500 deductible and will not be covered.

case_facts.description: four shingles blown off by wind
